title: Delivery Trucks for Kids! Mail Truck, Forklift and More
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bolt the little tow truck, and welcome to Tiny Truck Town!
Today we're meeting five vehicles that carry things from place to place.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Some carry letters, some carry boxes, and one carries cars! Let's find out.

lines: Here's our first stop. Here's a clue: it brings letters and packages to your house! Can you guess?
A mail truck carries lots and lots of mail.
Letters, cards and packages ride inside, all sorted and ready to go.
The mail carrier stops at every house on the street.
Can you pretend to open a letter? Hooray, it's for you!
Can you guess which side the steering wheel is often on?
The right side, close to the mailboxes!
Let's say it together: MAIL TRUCK!
One more time, nice and loud: MAIL TRUCK!
Mail carriers deliver in sunshine, rain and even snow.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it brings boxes right to your front door! Can you guess?
A delivery van brings packages to homes and shops.
Boxes big and small are stacked neatly inside.
The driver follows a map to find every address.
Can you carry a pretend box? Careful, it's heavy!
Can you guess how the driver gets the boxes out quickly?
A big sliding door opens wide on the side!
Let's say it together: DELIVERY VAN!
One more time, nice and loud: DELIVERY VAN!
Vans are smaller than big trucks, so they fit on little streets.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has two long forks for lifting heavy boxes! Can you guess?
A forklift works in big warehouses full of boxes.
Its two forks slide under a wooden tray called a pallet.
The boxes sit on the pallet, all stacked up together.
Can you hold out two fingers like forks? Slide and lift!
Can you guess where the forklift puts the boxes?
Way up high, on tall shelves!
One more time, nice and loud: FORKLIFT!
A heavy weight in the back keeps the forklift steady, so it won't tip.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has a big round tank on its back! Can you guess?
A tanker truck carries liquids, like water or milk.
The liquid rides inside the long, round tank.
Walls inside the tank help keep the liquid from sloshing too much.
Can you make a big round tank with your arms?
Can you guess how the liquid gets out?
Through a hose at the back! Glug, glug, glug!
Let's say it together: TANKER TRUCK!
One more time, nice and loud: TANKER TRUCK!
Milk tankers bring fresh milk from farms to the dairy.
Who's last? Here's a clue: it carries cars on top of cars! Can you guess?
A car carrier is a long truck with two floors.
Cars ride on the top floor and on the bottom floor.
It brings brand-new cars from the factory to car stores.
Let's count the cars! One, two, three, four, five, six, seven!
Can you guess how the cars get on and off?
They drive up and down a ramp!
Let's say it together: CAR CARRIER!
One more time, nice and loud: CAR CARRIER!
Some car carriers can carry up to ten cars at once.

recap: Wow, so many things to carry! Let's remember.
The mail truck brings letters to the mailbox.
The delivery van has a big sliding door.
The forklift lifts boxes up high.
The tanker truck carries water or milk.
And the car carrier has a ramp for cars!
outro: Which delivery truck was your favorite? Be kind, and say thank you to the people who bring your mail.
Bye, friends! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
